schoolInfo.tagline: Our School • Our Activities • Our Community
schoolInfo.introduction: Prathmik Vidyalaya Kareli Bagh is a dedicated primary learning institution committed to providing quality foundational education, holistic student development, and a joyful learning atmosphere for young learners in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. (School details can be fully customized by the Administrator).
schoolInfo.vision: To nurture every child’s potential through experiential learning, positive values, strong literacy, numeracy skills, and inclusive community engagement.
schoolInfo.mission: To foster a safe, clean, welcoming, and inspiring educational environment where every student thrives with curiosity, respect, and confidence.
schoolInfo.address: Kareli Bagh, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh 211016, India
schoolInfo.phone: School Contact — Update from Admin Panel
schoolInfo.timings: Monday - Saturday: 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM (Sundays & Public Holidays Closed)

principal.messageStudents: Dear children, come to school every day with curiosity in your eyes and kindness in your hearts. Every day is an opportunity to learn something new, make friends, and build your bright future.
principal.messageParents: Respected parents and guardians, your partnership with our school is the cornerstone of your child’s success. Together, we can ensure every child feels encouraged, valued, and empowered to reach their highest potential.

activities.title: Annual Sports Day & Athletics Meet
activities.description: A vibrant celebration of sportsmanship, physical wellness, and athletic talent featuring relay races, lemon spoon race, sack race, and yoga drills for primary learners.
activities.objectives: Encourage physical fitness, team camaraderie, and sportsmanship among all children.
activities.participation: All primary grade students from Class 1 to Class 5.
activities.results: Medals and encouragement certificates will be awarded to all participants.

activities.title: Green Earth Plantation Drive (Poshan Vatika)
activities.description: Students and teachers planting fruit saplings, flowering shrubs, and vegetable seeds in the school kitchen garden to learn about ecology and environmental care.
activities.objectives: Raise awareness about environmental conservation and develop eco-friendly habits.
activities.results: 50 new saplings planted across the campus.

activities.title: Swachhata Pakhwada — Clean Campus Awareness
activities.description: A two-week cleanliness initiative where students, teachers, and staff organized handwashing demonstrations, classroom tidying drives, and poster making.
activities.objectives: Inculcate personal hygiene, proper handwashing rituals, and waste management practices.
activities.results: Classrooms awarded stars for cleanliness; student handwashing monitors recognized.
teachersInvolved: Health & Hygiene In-charge — Update from Admin

activities.title: Primary Science & Math Learning Exhibition
activities.description: Hands-on display of simple math puzzles, model clocks, geometric shapes, and natural science collections created by students from recycled materials.
activities.objectives: Build foundational numeracy, observational science skills, and joyful problem solving.
activities.results: Over 40 working models and charts presented to parents and visitors.
teachersInvolved: Mathematics & Science Teachers — Update from Admin

activities.title: Independence Day Celebrations & Cultural Program
activities.description: Flag hoisting ceremony, national anthem, patriotic group songs, student speeches in Hindi and English, and distribution of mid-day sweets.
activities.objectives: Foster patriotism, constitutional values, and cultural appreciation.
activities.participation: All students, staff, and village education committee members.
activities.results: Cultural dances and songs presented with enthusiastic community presence.
teachersInvolved: Cultural Program Committee — Update from Admin

facilities.name: Primary Classrooms
facilities.description: Well-ventilated, naturally lit, and cheerful classrooms equipped with child-friendly seating, teaching-learning materials (TLM), blackboards, and colorful learning charts.
facilities.importance: Provides a safe, encouraging space where children spend their core academic hours developing literacy and numeracy.

facilities.name: School Kitchen & Mid-Day Meal Dining
facilities.description: Hygienic and dedicated kitchen space adhering to strict government nutrition guidelines for preparing hot, fresh, and nutritious mid-day meals daily.
features: Clean cooking area with LPG stoves
Daily menu adherence for balanced nutrition
facilities.importance: Ensures every student receives wholesome nutrition, boosting concentration, health, and classroom attendance.

facilities.name: Kitchen Garden (Poshan Vatika)
facilities.description: An organic garden cultivated on campus where seasonal vegetables and herbs are grown. Serves both as an educational laboratory and a fresh source for meals.
features: Composting pit for organic green waste
Native flower shrubs and biodiversity corner
facilities.importance: Connects students to nature, teaches food origin, and supplements mid-day meals with fresh organic greens.

facilities.name: Playground & Sports Area
facilities.description: An open, secure outdoor play area where children enjoy daily morning assembly, physical exercise, games like Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, and recreational free play.
features: Sports equipment kit (footballs, skipping ropes, badminton)
Open space for morning assembly and physical drills
facilities.importance: Essential for motor skills development, teamwork, stress relief, and physical fitness of growing children.

facilities.name: Library Corner & Reading Room
facilities.description: A cozy reading corner featuring illustrated storybooks in Hindi and English, children’s magazines, folk tales, and beginner encyclopedia volumes.
features: Illustrated picture books for early readers
facilities.importance: Builds early literacy, language comprehension, and a lifelong passion for reading books.

facilities.name: Safe Drinking Water & Sanitation Facility
facilities.description: Purified drinking water taps and clean, separate washroom facilities for boys and girls with dedicated handwashing stations.
features: Filtered and tested potable drinking water
Separate, secure toilets for girls and boys
Multiple handwash points with soap dispensers
facilities.importance: Foundational for health, hygiene, dignity, and student retention, especially for girl students.

announcements.title: Admissions Open for Academic Session 2026-27
announcements.description: Admissions are now open for Class 1 to Class 5 at Prathmik Vidyalaya Kareli Bagh. Parents and guardians are requested to visit the school office with the child’s Aadhaar card, birth certificate, and photographs during working hours.

announcements.title: Monthly Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM) Scheduled
announcements.description: The monthly parent-teacher meeting will be held on the last working Saturday of the month. We invite all parents to review student workbooks, discuss progress, and explore the school campus.

announcements.title: Free Textbook & Notebook Distribution Complete
announcements.description: All registered students of Classes 1 through 5 have received government-provided textbooks and exercise notebooks. Please ensure children bring their books according to the daily timetable.

announcements.title: School Timing Notice for Summer/Monsoon Season
announcements.description: Notice regarding school opening and closing hours as prescribed by the Basic Education Department. Morning assembly begins sharply at 8:00 AM. Please ensure students arrive on time.
